attribution: José P. Marques and contributors, MP2RAGE-related-scripts
citation: Marques JP, Gruetter R (2013). New Developments and Applications of the MP2RAGE Sequence: Focusing the Contrast and High Spatial Resolution R1 Mapping. PLoS ONE 8:e69294. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0069294
processing: UNI, INV1 and INV2: lossless gzip only. B1: source Sa2RAGE_B1map.nii.gz divided by 1000 and stored as float32 relative B1, following DemoForR1Correction.m. No resampling, cropping, masking or synthetic image generation.
limitations: The repository supplies no participant demographics or explicit defacing statement. This example uses an already measured B1 map; it does not demonstrate estimating B1 from raw SA2RAGE contrasts.
